chapters.title: Mischievous Mansion
chapters.subtitle: Chapter I
chapters.description: Uncover the secrets hidden within an illager fortress, tainted by something dark.
chapters.lore:
Step into the shadows of the Mischievous Mansion. Recently appeared without a trace, its eerie halls hold secrets waiting to be unraveled. Explore its many twisting passages, face challenging enemies, and uncover the mysteries that have been concealed for so long.

Within the mansion, every room reveals a new puzzle, every flickering candle a clue, every creaking floorboard a warning, and every shadow a potential threat. Work together with your team to overcome the unpredictable dangers lurking around every corner.

Rumor has it: the mobs have become more evolved over the years… adapting to those who dare enter.
chapters.roadmapText: The passage is open. Your journey awaits.

chapters.title: Baneful Bastion
chapters.subtitle: Chapter II
chapters.description: Venture into the depths of the Nether's cindering realm.
chapters.lore:
The Nether was never meant to be conquered. Yet here you stand, at the threshold of something older than the world above.

The Bastion does not welcome the living. Its walls of blackstone remember every soul that has passed through, and every soul that never left.

Piglin war-horns echo through volcanic corridors. Gold is the only language spoken here—and you are running out of words.

qa.question: What is Enigma: Beyond the Void?
qa.answer: Enigma: Beyond the Void is a story-driven Minecraft adventure map told across interconnected chapters, each with a unique theme, custom structures, handcrafted dungeons, and original bosses. No mods or datapacks required — only custom plugins power the experience.

qa.question: How many players can play at once?
qa.answer: Up to 10 players can join a session. The chapters are designed to be challenging enough for larger groups while still being completable by smaller teams.

qa.question: Do I need any mods or texture packs?
qa.answer: No mods are required. Enigma runs entirely on a custom plugin server with vanilla Minecraft. No texture packs, datapacks, or mod loaders needed.

qa.question: What Minecraft version does Enigma use?
qa.answer: Enigma runs on a specific server version maintained by the team. Check the Discord for the latest version information and server IP when play sessions are open.

qa.question: How difficult are the chapters?
qa.answer: Each chapter scales in difficulty. Chapter I (Mischievous Mansion) is designed as an introduction, while Chapter II (Baneful Bastion) ramps up significantly. Coming chapters will push teams even further.

qa.question: Can I explore chapters in any order?
qa.answer: Chapters are designed to be played in order, as the story and difficulty progression builds upon each previous chapter. The narrative connections between chapters are a core part of the experience.

qa.question: What happens if my team dies?
qa.answer: The chapter has built-in respawn mechanics. Dying is not the end — but repeated failure against bosses may reset certain encounter phases. Coordinate with your team to manage resources and revives.

qa.question: Is there an overarching story connecting all chapters?
qa.answer: Yes. Each chapter reveals new fragments of a larger mystery centered around a force called The Void. Lore entries, boss dialogues, and hidden secrets all weave into a single continuous narrative.

qa.question: Where can I find more lore?
qa.answer: Explore the chapters to uncover the story through hidden discoveries, encounters, and the world itself. Each chapter overview introduces the journey ahead.

qa.question: How do I join the server or get updates?
qa.answer: Join the official Discord server to get notified about play sessions, server access, chapter releases, and community events. The team posts all announcements there first.

announcements.title: It’s Quiet… Almost a Little Too Quiet.
announcements.content:
Something stirs beyond the Void. Keep your eyes open, adventurer.
The next fragment draws near — and when it arrives, nothing will be as it was.

Prepare yourself. The Void does not wait.
